edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: adults exposed to traffic-related air pollution
edges.mechanism: Black carbon is a marker of combustion-derived ultrafine particles that provoke oxidative stress, endothelial dysfunction, and thrombosis-relevant inflammation.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2022 McCunney meta analysis in Front Public Health, which ties black carbon exposure to cardiovascular disease in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
